title: Generated fold-frame accessors
summary: Uses compiler-generated frame shape and getter theorems together with shared result-frame getters to avoid proof-local projection lemmas.
premises: An exact matched array-fold region with a generated continuing frame
For result placement, a valid nonparameter result local
For preservation, a distinct valid nonparameter read local and its getter
result: The proof reads exact continuing-frame slots from compiler-generated theorems and reads or preserves result-frame slots through shared semantic theorems.
